commit.message:
Skip needless epub recompression for -S and no-op -f

-S extracted the cover but still rebuilt and rezipped the OPF even
though nothing was edited. -f also rezipped every time even when the
cover metadata was already correct. Both now only touch the archive
when something actually changed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

files.patch:
@@ -1132,8 +1132,10 @@ if [[ -z "$quiet_mode" && -n "$edit_mode" ]]; then
 fi
 
 if [[ -z "$opf_file" ]]; then
-	format_opf > "$epub_opf"
-	zip -q -Xr9D "$epub_file" "$epub_opf"
+	if [[ -n "$edit_mode" ]]; then
+		format_opf > "$epub_opf"
+		zip -q -Xr9D "$epub_file" "$epub_opf"
+	fi
 else
 	format_opf > "$opf_file"
 fi
@@ -1442,19 +1444,33 @@ if [[ -n "$alt_cover_path" ]]; then
 fi
 
 if [[ -n "$fix_cover_given" ]]; then
+	cp "$new_opf_header" "$new_opf_header.before-fix"
+	cp "$opf_footer" "$opf_footer.before-fix"
+
 	change_cover_id "$id"
-	format_opf > "$epub_opf"
 
 	# Fix incorrect cover path case (i.e., Cover.jpg -> cover.jpg)
-        new_href="$(unzip -l "$epub_file" | grep -iom1 "$href")" || true
-        if [[ -n "$new_href" && "$new_href" != "$href" ]]; then
-                sed_i "s#$href#$new_href#" "$epub_opf"
-                href="$new_href"
-        fi
-
-	zip -q -Xr9D "$epub_file" "$epub_opf"
+	new_href="$(unzip -l "$epub_file" | grep -iom1 "$href")" || true
+	href_case_fixed=""
+	if [[ -n "$new_href" && "$new_href" != "$href" ]]; then
+		href_case_fixed=1
+	fi
 
-	log "Successfully set internal image as cover: $href [$id]"
+	if diff -q "$new_opf_header.before-fix" "$new_opf_header" \
+			> /dev/null \
+			&& diff -q "$opf_footer.before-fix" "$opf_footer" \
+			> /dev/null \
+			&& [[ -z "$href_case_fixed" ]]; then
+		log "Cover already correctly set: $href [$id]"
+	else
+		format_opf > "$epub_opf"
+		if [[ -n "$href_case_fixed" ]]; then
+			sed_i "s#$href#$new_href#" "$epub_opf"
+			href="$new_href"
+		fi
+		zip -q -Xr9D "$epub_file" "$epub_opf"
+		log "Successfully set internal image as cover: $href [$id]"
+	fi
 fi
 
 if [[ -n "$out_cover_path" ]]; then
